in_sanskrit.name: माघ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Magha is derived from the Sanskrit word माघ (Māgha), which refers to the month of Magha in the Hindu calendar. The month of Magha is considered sacred and is dedicated to Lord Shiva. It falls in January or February in the Gregorian calendar.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Magha in Hindi is the same as in Sanskrit, which refers to the month of Magha in the Hindu calendar. It is a month dedicated to Lord Shiva.

in_tamil.name: மாகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Mākā is derived from the Sanskrit name Māgha. It is also the name of the month of Magha in the Tamil calendar.

in_telugu.name: మాఘ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Māgha is the same as in Sanskrit, which refers to the month of Magha in the Hindu calendar. It is a month dedicated to Lord Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Magha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon, Bright, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Magha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Magha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'magnam', which means 'great' or 'large'. In Hindu mythology, the month of Magha is named after the god Maghavan, an alternate name for Indra, the god of rain and thunder. The name Magha is associated with the brightness and radiance of the moon and is considered an auspicious name for a girl.
